_about: Hardware description for mini58_cal.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_columns: Columns for SG0..SG5 in order. Jade .BIN files are read directly (time, gains from the file); CSV needs these names.
_ref: Optional: channel that measures the shared Vexc/2 reference against AGND (e.g. CH6). Each gage channel then reads (g - ref) and the script adds the measured ref back. Leave null if not logged.
_exc: Optional but recommended: channel logging the bridge excitation through a divider. Vexc = exc_ratio x V at the ADC. Every gage sample is scaled by exc_nominal / Vexc (ratiometric).
_units: counts = signed ADS131M08 code, counts_u24 = raw 24-bit word, or V / mV / uV if Jade already converts. pga_gain per channel: start at 1, raise after quicklook/rangecheck (see procedure).
_front_end: V at sensor = ratio x V at ADC pins. 1 for the bare transducer wired straight to Jade.
_sign: +1 if the gage wire is on AINxP, -1 if it is on AINxN (current wiring: CH1 P, CH2 N, CH3 P, CH4 N, CH5 P, CH6 N).
_g: Local gravity, Montreal / Sherbrooke area ~9.806-9.807 m/s2. The 0.01 % difference does not matter here.
_calibration: Label on the sensor: SI-700-30, SI-1400-60 or SI-2800-120. Used only to express errors in % FS. null if unknown.
